_comment_: Direct-download manifest consumed by /install. The DownloadsTable in src/pages/Install.jsx fetches this file at runtime, so a new release does NOT require a website rebuild — just update this file and push. Fields per asset: platform (display label), file (exact filename matching .github/workflows/release.yml), sha256 (full hex from SHA256SUMS), size (human string), url (download link).
_comment_update_: After the GitHub Release is published: 1) download SHA256SUMS from the release; 2) replace each asset's sha256 with its full hex digest from that file; 3) replace size with the actual MB string from the release UI; 4) bump version + date + notesUrl. Until then 'pending' renders as-is in the table.
